rounds.text: The stock sits at the very bottom of its valuation spectrum, resting only 3% of the way up its 52-week range between a low of 43 and a high of 103 [E5]. This severe price depression is backed by fundamental deterioration, as compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months has turned negative at -10% [E19]. Compounding this contraction, the signal engine explicitly flags that earnings growth is decelerating [E64]. Furthermore, the company offers zero return to shareholders in cash flow, carrying a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4]. Conceded: the business shows strong multi-year historical profit growth of 55% over 5 years and 24% over 3 years alongside solid recent sales expansion [E17, E18, E59, E60]. However, this historical outperformance is severely undermined by the current negative trailing profit trajectory and the complete lack of dividend support [E4, E19].
